prompt: How should the editor correct the draft handout?
promptZh: 編輯應如何修正紙本資料草稿？
evidence: If the field reads WITHHOLD, use the collection number below the print; do not put a name there. / P26, Ticket punch: wall only. Signed name field: WITHHOLD. / The first field in each entry is the collection number to use for the corresponding photograph. / the draft still shows the ticket punch owner's name beneath the photograph.

options.text: Leave the owner’s name in place.
options.why: The withholding entry precludes a name beneath P26.
options.whyZh: P26 註明不公開，不可在照片下方放姓名。

options.why: P26 is allowed in the handout; P32 is map-only.
options.whyZh: P26 可用於紙本資料；P32 只可用於地圖。

options.text: Keep the photo but replace the name with P26.
options.zh: 保留照片，並用 P26 取代姓名。
options.why: The WITHHOLD rule requires the collection number in place of the name.
options.whyZh: 不公開的規則要求以館藏編號代替姓名。

options.text: Put the literal word WITHHOLD below the photo.
options.zh: 在照片下方直接印上 WITHHOLD。
options.why: WITHHOLD is an internal instruction, not the printed credit.
options.whyZh: WITHHOLD 是內部指示，不是要印出的署名。

explanationZh: 不公開的規則要求以館藏編號代替姓名。
